facts.fact: 转折点：女主问起继母 Eloise 在不在，父亲尴尬地低声承认——他与 Eloise 已离婚；女主在心里暗自鼓掌。
facts.anchor: He rubs his chin uncomfortably, looking hesitant. “We got a divorce,” he whispers.

facts.fact: 父亲答离婚竟发生在 two years ago；女主为父女 ten years 不通音信全是白费而愤怒——他不联系她只是怕 Eloise 离开。
facts.anchor: “Two years ago,” he mumbles with his eyes to the ground.

facts.fact: 女主回想：继母 Eloise 在她生命里的 sixteen years 中说爱她的次数双手可数；她一直猜对方恨她只因自己酷似生母。
facts.anchor: the number of times she told me she loved me throughout the sixteen years she was in my life.

facts.fact: 女主落泪不是为前夫 Graham，而是想到 twenty-eight years old 还要从头再来；她向父亲坦白：结过婚、现已离婚，这就是她回来的原因。
facts.anchor: Not at the thought of Graham, but picturing the fact that I have to start over again at twenty-eight years old.

facts.fact: 回忆被离开那天：挚友 Maggie 上门低声告知 Graham 将搬去她男友 Steven 家住；Maggie 随后陪了她 three days，证实 Graham 确实要离婚。
facts.anchor: “Graham is going to be staying with Steven,” she’d whispered to me.

facts.fact: 女主签下离婚协议、最后一次见到前夫 Graham，至今已 eight months。
facts.anchor: It’s been eight months since we signed the divorce papers and since I’ve seen Graham.

facts.fact: 父亲道出离婚内因：Eloise 早在另一家银行私藏存款、蓄谋拆散婚姻多年；他自认懦弱、以酒度日，最后开口要她离开。
facts.anchor: she was hiding money at a separate bank. She was planning our demise for a long time

facts.fact: 父亲说离婚手续办妥后便戒酒、至今保持清醒 two years；房子归他，大部分存款归 Eloise。
facts.anchor: I’ve been sober for two years now. I stopped drinking once it was official.
